waypoints.title: Four waypoints from confusion to clarity.
waypoints.subtitle: No generic quiz. PathFinders builds a picture of you camp by camp, checking its understanding with you at every stop.
waypoints.wp1Body: Academic record, personal background, and where you're starting from — the map's first pin.
waypoints.wp2Body: Interest and personality assessments surface what actually pulls at your attention, not just what you're good at.
waypoints.wp3Body: An AI conversation digs into your goals and doubts the way a good mentor would — patiently, and in your words.
waypoints.wp4Body: A shortlist of career paths, matched and ranked, with the reasoning behind every one made visible to you.

features.title: Built to understand the whole person, not just the transcript.
features.feat1Body: Academics, interests, personality, and goals are weighed together, not scored in separate silos.
features.feat2Body: Ask questions, push back, change your mind — the guidance adapts in real time as you talk.
features.feat3Body: Every recommendation comes with the "why" behind it, so you can trust it or challenge it.
features.feat4Title: A plan, not just a title
features.feat4Body: Courses, certifications, and milestones laid out as a route you can actually follow.
features.feat5Body: The same rigor for a student picking a stream and a professional plotting a pivot.
features.feat6Body: Interests shift. Your plan updates with you instead of freezing you at day one.

portals.title: Wherever you're setting out from.
portals.studentBody: Turn academic performance and curiosity into a shortlist of degrees and careers worth pursuing.
portals.parentBody: See your child's assessment summary, so conversations at home start from the same page.
portals.switchBody: See how your experience transfers, and what the realistic next step actually looks like.

postcard.quote: I didn't need another quiz that called me an 'ENFP creative type.' I needed something to ask why I actually kept opening those biology tabs at 1am.

assessments.title: Career Fit & Personality Assessment
assessments.subtitle: Ten quick questions to find your interest type and working style
assessments.q1: When solving a problem, what do you naturally do first?
assessments.q1_o1: Sketch a diagram or build a quick physical prototype
assessments.q1_o2: Dig into the raw data, research papers, or documentation
assessments.q1_o3: Brainstorm creative metaphors and out-of-the-box angles
assessments.q1_o4: Talk to people affected and listen to their personal stories
assessments.q2: Which weekend project sounds most satisfying to finish?
assessments.q2_o1: Assembling mechanical parts or setting up electronics
assessments.q2_o2: Writing a python script to analyze sports or exam statistics
assessments.q2_o3: Designing a visual portfolio, short film, or branding concept
assessments.q2_o4: Organizing a community study group or volunteering drive
assessments.q3: In a team expedition, which role do you instinctively take?
assessments.q3_o1: The Navigator who plans the exact route and gear checklists
assessments.q3_o2: The Strategist who forecasts risks and analyzes terrain data
assessments.q3_o3: The Storyteller who documents the ascent and inspires the team
assessments.q3_o4: The Anchor who resolves conflicts and keeps team morale high
